'''The Silencer''' was a virtually silent [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] favored by [[Spy/Legends|spies]] and [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]]. For this reason, it was banned by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Sometime following [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] found one of these pistols in the [[Stomach/Legends|stomach]] of a slain [[Urnsor'is]] eviscerater in the [[Myyydril Caverns/Legends|Myyydril Caverns]] on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]].<ref name="ROTW" />
